patches.reason: dsh-plugin-subagent-director 0.5.5 hands jobs.start() the Agent object as the job owner instead of that agent's session id. dsh-jobs-local resolveOwner() looks the owner up as a live session, finds nothing and throws 'session "[object Object]" has no live agent (background job owner must be live)', so every subagent_role call that sets run_in_background: true fails before the subagent is ever started. The core subagent tool already passes parent.id (dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js), and dsh-tool-bash does the same; only this plugin gets it wrong.
